name: MG12 warhead launcher
description: The MG12 warhead launcher, also known as the MG12 missile launcher, was a type of missile launcher that could deploy variable ordnance. Produced by Krupx, some BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighters were equipped with a pair of these by Resistance personnel for its versatility compared to the standard Arakyd Flex Tube proton torpedo launchers.
